title: A Terminal for the Gravity
author: E. M. Ravensworth
blurb: Astrid Coldharbour, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
